description: Get an app's database schema — every table and its columns. Always call this before writing a query with vibekit_db_query.
name: vibekit_db_schema

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Full database schema: tables, columns, and types.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Database Schema
